responsibility: Implements the operational range-tracking logic for early VRP’s dominator-walk analyzer. The evrp_range_analyzer here enters and leaves basic blocks with an unwind stack, derives temporary and global SSA value ranges from incoming conditional edges, PHI nodes, and range-producing statements, updates classic vr_values state and optional global SSA range metadata, and restores shadowed ranges when control leaves scope; it is the file that owns EVRP’s scoped assertion propagation and statement/edge-to-range extraction behavior, distinct from the pass driver that runs folding over the CFG.
same_name_distinction: Provides the out-of-line implementation of the evrp_range_analyzer declared in gcc/gimple-ssa-evrp-analyze.h, including the dominator-walk block enter/leave actions, edge/PHI/statement range extraction, and stack-based push/pop unwinding of temporary SSA ranges.
